name: Tend Counseling
tagline: Unhurried, practical therapy for adults and couples — in person in Portland and online across Oregon and Washington.
license_note: Licensed Marriage & Family Therapist · Oregon #T2291 · Washington #LF61044
service_area: In person in Portland · Online across Oregon & Washington
hours_note: Sessions by appointment. No weekend sessions.
crisis_note: Tend is not an emergency service. If you are in crisis, call or text 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline) or call 911.

steps.title: A free 15-minute call
steps.body: Tell me a little about what's going on. I'll ask a few questions, you can ask me anything, and we'll see if it feels like a fit.

steps.title: Your first session
steps.body: Fifty minutes to get the whole picture — what brought you here, what you've tried, and what you'd like to be different.

steps.title: Settle into a rhythm
steps.body: Most people start weekly, then space sessions out as things steady. You set the pace, and we check in on it together.

progress.title: Sunday evenings stop feeling like a cliff edge.
progress.body: The week ahead is still busy. It just isn't loud in your head at 9pm.

progress.title: An argument stays an argument.
progress.body: It ends in the kitchen instead of following you both to bed and into Tuesday.

progress.title: You can name what you feel before it names you.
progress.body: Tired, disappointed, overstretched — words that turn a fog into something you can work with.

progress.title: Rest feels like rest again.
progress.body: A free afternoon that doesn't come with a list of what you should be doing instead.

insurance.title: In network
insurance.body: Aetna, Providence Health Plan and Regence BlueCross BlueShield. Bring your card to the first session and we'll check your benefits together.

insurance.title: Out of network
insurance.body: I provide a monthly superbill you can submit for reimbursement. Many plans return 50–80% of the fee — worth a call to yours.

insurance.title: Sliding scale
insurance.body: A few weekly spots are held at $95–$140 for students, artists, and anyone between jobs. Just ask — no paperwork to prove it.

art_direction.identity: Inner weather: a cool mist canvas, periwinkle dawn skies drawn in CSS with fine grain, one apricot sun, night-blue ink. Calm, adult and quietly modern. Never sage-and-beige, never leaves or lotuses, never the eyes-closed-in-the-sunshine stock photo.
art_direction.type: Rethink Sans (medium, tight tracking) for UI, body and the first half of every headline; Spectral italic (light) for the feeling half — 'A calmer place / to think out loud.' Numbers and captions also in Spectral italic.
art_direction.color: One accent: apricot (bg-primary) for the primary button and the sun in each sky — nothing else. Periwinkle (sky-dawn / bg-sky) carries the hero and one band. Night (bg-secondary / sky-night) carries the contact band and footer. Everything else is mist canvas, white cards, ink and muted text. Never add another color.
art_direction.signature: The inner-weather forecast — specialties typeset as a forecast table, each with a weather glyph, a condition, a first-person line in italic ('I can't switch my brain off'), and what the work looks like. Keep it wherever the design evolves.
art_direction.voice: Warm, plain and unhurried, written in the therapist's own first person. Short sentences, concrete everyday outcomes, honest numbers. No exclamation marks, no 'healing journey', no 'you are not alone', no testimonials.
